newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Santander to pay 81 pta interim div.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Santander to pay 81 pta interim div.

text.p: The annual shareholders meeting of Spain's Santander Bank approved on Saturday payment of a gross interim dividend on 1997 profits of 81 pesetas, an increase of 15.7 percent.
After a three-way share split, also approved by shareholders, the dividend per new share will be 27 pesetas. The face value of a new share after the split is 250 pesetas.
The dividend will be paid after July 31 of this year.
The shareholders also agreed to name Francisco Luzon as board member and director general of the bank.
